preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, str) and len(t) == 5 and t[2] == ':' for t in times)
preconditions.description: Each time in the input list must be a string in the format 'HH:MM'.
The input list must contain at least one time.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(t[:2]) <= 23 and 0 <= int(t[3:]) <= 59 for t in times)
preconditions.description: Each time must represent a valid hour (0-23) and minute (0-59).

postconditions.description: If there is only one unique time, the output must be '23:59'.
The output must represent the maximum time interval between alarms in 'HH:MM' format.
